title: Answer: conscious information is what correlates with report

statements.text: Following Dehaene, subjective reports are the data a science of consciousness studies. Conscious brain information is the information that correlates with those reports, and EEG and MEG, which measure the brain field, already serve to detect consciousness.

sources.quote: subjective reports are the key phenomena that a cognitive neuroscience of consciousness purport to study
are routinely used to detect signs of consciousness in anaesthesia
